'''Sadruddin Ahmed Chowdhury''' (1 January 1931 – 23 July 2016) was a Bangladeshi academic and physicist.<ref name=star>{{cite news | url=https://www.thedailystar.net/city/first-sust-vc-dr-sadruddin-passes-away-1258396 | title=First Sust VC Dr Sadruddin passes away | work=The Daily Star | date=24 July 2016 | accessdate=24 July 2016}}</ref> He was one of the instrumental figures in founding [[Shahjalal University of Science and Technology]] (SUST) and served as the first [[vice-chancellor]] of the university from 1989 to 1994. He also served as the vice-chancellor of [[Sylhet International University]] from 2001 to 2011.<ref name=siu>{{cite web | url=https://www.siu.edu.bd/founder-vice-chancellor/ | title=Founder Vice Chancellor | publisher=Sylhet International University | accessdate=24 July 2016}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Chowdhury passed matriculation exam from [[Sylhet Government Pilot High School]], Sylhet. He got his bachelor's and master's in Physics from the [[University of Dhaka]] in 1951 and 1954 respectively. He obtained his Ph.D. degree in [[Crystallography]] from the [[University of Manchester]] in 1966.<ref name=siu/>

Chowdhury worked as a professor of physics at [[Rajshahi University]]<ref>{{cite web | url=http://dept.ru.ac.bd/apee/apee_archives/teacherlist.php?pageno=1&t=teacher&RecPerPage=ALL | title=Archives | publisher=Rajshahi University | accessdate=24 July 2016 | archive-date=10 August 2017 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170810212156/http://dept.ru.ac.bd/apee/apee_archives/teacherlist.php?pageno=1&t=teacher&RecPerPage=ALL | url-status=dead }}</ref> and [[Al Fateh University]]. Later he joined as the vice-Chancellor of [[Shahjalal University of Science and Technology|SUST]] in 1989. His daughter Dr. Nazia Chowdhury obtained bachelor's and master's degree in Physics from SUST, PhD from [[University of Cambridge]] and currently is a professor at SUST.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sust.edu/d/phy/faculty-profile-detail/151/17|title = Shahjalal University of Science & Technology}}</ref>
